facts.rationale: Corrects the claim that all text pointers are cleared and preserves the independently scheduled input/display lifetime distinction.
facts.value: The Data-menu Special confirmation calls mnInfo_80252758 and requests removal of the outgoing Data-menu GObj. This unit prepares an availability-first, ascending-timestamp message permutation, then uses scroll_idx to select up to four paired timestamp and authored-message rows. Arrow children reflect available-entry bounds. On departure, display callbacks destroy and clear each populated row slot, destroy description text without clearing its pointer, and schedule terminal display-GObj destruction. The global mnInfo_804D6C78 pointer is not cleared here. The separate input callback reads that retained pointer, so its safe lifetime across transition depends on external process management.
